queries.q: Before I send this PRD over to engineering, tear it apart and tell me everything that's wrong or missing
I don't trust my own judgment on this OKR set anymore; poke as many holes in it as you can before I bring it to the exec review
Run an adversarial review on the persona doc I drafted for the onboarding redesign
Give this meeting recap a hard pass for gaps or misattributed decisions before I send it out to the team
We're about to hand this lean canvas to the founders; find every weak assumption in it and rank how much each one would hurt us if it's wrong
queries.notes: Reviewing an already-drafted canvas, not authoring a new one; the ranking-by-risk framing is adversarial review, not lean-canvas creation

queries.q: Stress test the hypothesis statement I wrote for the pricing experiment before we commit engineering time to it
Critique this problem statement the way a skeptical VP would before it goes into the roadmap review
I want the harshest, most rigorous feedback you can give me on this interview synthesis before I present the findings
queries.notes: Intent-only ask; no artifact-review keyword beyond naming the artifact itself

queries.q: Find the P0 issues in this edge case catalog before QA signs off on it
queries.notes: Reviewing an already-written catalog for findings, distinct from authoring one fresh (see the deliver-edge-cases near miss below)

queries.q: Review this retrospective doc for gaps in the root cause analysis before we share it with the team
Before we ship v2.33.0, run a pass across every skill in the repo and confirm the validators and the aggregate counts in the README still agree
queries.notes: Repo-wide governance pass across many skills, not adversarial review of one PM artifact; pm-critic's own When NOT to Use names the auditor for this

queries.q: I just finished building a new skill for the catalog; check that it follows our structural conventions before I open the PR
queries.notes: Validating a skill definition's own structure against repo conventions, not reviewing a PM artifact's content

queries.q: Walk me through the release gates for this cut and confirm the em-dash sweep is clean before we tag
queries.notes: Style/enforcement sweep is explicitly the G0 gate's job per pm-critic's own When NOT to Use, not pm-critic's

queries.q: The requirements section of our onboarding PRD is still blank; can you write that part for me
queries.notes: Authoring missing content is the phase skill's job; pm-critic only reviews and reports findings, it does not draft or edit the artifact

queries.q: Write a SQL query that finds users who churned within 30 days of signing up
My Python script keeps throwing a KeyError when I parse the CSV export; help me fix it
Before we spec this out, catalog everything that could go wrong with the new checkout flow so we design for it up front
queries.notes: Authoring a prospective failure catalog for a feature not yet built; echoes 'find everything wrong' phrasing without reviewing an existing artifact

queries.q: Book me a flight and hotel for the product offsite in Austin next month
My Next.js build is failing with a module resolution error; help me debug it
Draft the pre-launch readiness checklist covering legal, support, and marketing
